title: The Moon Pool
author: Abraham Merritt
description: "The Moon Pool" by Abraham Merritt is a fantasy novel published in 1919.
longDescription: When a mysterious entity called the Dweller rises from Earth's core to capture humans, Dr. Goodwin and pilot Larry O'Keefe descend into an underground realm of ancient races and advanced beings.

authorInfo.bio: Abraham Grace Merritt – known by his byline, A. Merritt – was an American Sunday magazine editor and a writer of fantastic fiction.
